text: An offer from Saudi Arabia for Barcelona's Brazil winger Raphinha, 29, might boost 28-year-old England forward Marcus Rashford's hopes of joining the La Liga club from Manchester United . (Talksport)

Crysencio Summerville's impressive World Cup performances for the Netherlands are affecting Manchester United 's hopes of signing him, with Paris St-Germain now also interested in the 24-year-old West Ham winger. ( Mirror)
Manchester United have no interest in selling 23-year-old Slovenia striker Benjamin Sesko this summer, despite interest from Barcelona and Atletico Madrid . (Teamtalk)
Brighton are weighing up whether to hand Yasin Ayari a new contract or allow the Sweden midfielder, 22, to leave amid growing interest from Newcastle . (Football Insider)
Arsenal are hopeful Declan Rice can help persuade fellow England midfielder Morgan Rogers, 23, to join them from Aston Villa this summer. (Mirror)

Juventus' summer transfer list includes Aston Villa 's Argentina goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez, 33, and 32-year-old England defender John Stones, who left Manchester City this summer. (Gazzetta dello Sport - in Italian)
Leeds have lodged an opening bid worth about £20m with Southampton for Northern Ireland midfielder Shea Charles, 22. (Teamtalk)
Senegal striker Nicolas Jackson, 25, will not push for a move away from Chelsea as he aims to impress new manager Xabi Alonso in pre-season. (Football Insider)
Stade Rennais are set to move for Sunderland 's 21-year-old Spanish striker Eliezer Mayenda. (Foot Mercato - in French)
West Ham are exploring a move for 31-year-old English defender Adam Webster, who is a free agent after leaving Brighton at the end of the season. (Sun)
If Orlando City buy Mexico striker Santiago Gimenez, 25, from AC Milan then the Italians will make a move for PSG's Portugal striker Goncalo Ramos, 25. (Corriere dello Sport - in Italian)

Chelsea are keeping tabs on Liverpool 's Florian Wirtz - who starred under new Blues boss Xabi Alonso at Bayer Leverkusen - but any potential deal for the Germany playmaker, 23, depends on Argentina midfielder Enzo Fernandez, 25, leaving Stamford Bridge. (Football Insider)
Germany midfielder Felix Nmecha is open to leaving Borussia Dortmund and both Liverpool and Manchester United are interested in the 25-year-old. (Teamtalk)
Newcastle could be willing to sell Germany striker Nick Woltemade, 24, with Aston Villa , Dortmund and Atletico Madrid among his suitors. (AS - in Spanish)
Brighton have made an improved offer for Tottenham 's 19-year-old Croatia centre-back Luka Vuskovic worth up to £45m, including add-ons. (Mail)
RB Leipzig expect Paris St-Germain to submit an offer for Ivory Coast winger Yan Diomande, 19, after turning down Liverpool 's opening bid of 100m euros (£87m). (Bild - in German)

If England midfielder Elliot Anderson, 23, joins Manchester City it could spark a domino effect, with Nottingham Forest signing 26-year-old Italy midfielder Davide Frattesi from Inter Milan , who in turn will look to complete a deal for Liverpool 's England midfielder Curtis Jones, 25. (Gazzetta dello Sport - in Italian)
Leeds United have offered a long-term contract to 29-year-old Wales winger Harry Wilson, who is a free agent after his Fulham contract expired. (Football Insider)
Bayern Munich will look to renegotiate Michael Olise's contract amid interest from Real Madrid and PSG in the 24-year-old France winger. (AS - in Spanish)
Real Madrid have denied reports they have already made contact with Olise's camp. (Sport - in Spanish)
Juventus are willing to sell Canada forward Jonathan David, 26, and have set an asking price of 30m euros (£26m). (Corriere dello Sport - in Italian)

PSG want 40m euros (£35m) for Randal Kolo Muani and the 27-year-old France forward is keen to return to Juventus , who are also considering a move for Atletico Madrid's Norway striker Alexander Sorloth, 30. (Corriere dello Sport - in Italian)
Manchester City are close to reaching a financial settlement with Chelsea that will enable them to appoint Enzo Maresca as their manager. (Guardian)
Tottenham are ready to test the water with a bid for Crystal Palace 's England midfielder Adam Wharton, 22. (Teamtalk)
RB Leipzig have turned down an offer of £87m from Liverpool for Ivory Coast winger Yan Diomande as they want £113m for the 19-year-old. (Liverpool Echo)
Fulham have had a £17m bid rejected by Turkish club Trabzonspor for 22-year-old Nigeria defender Chibuike Nwaiwu. (Fotomac - in Turkish)
Tottenham are not planning to make a move for striker Mason Greenwood, while Roma are currently short of Marseille's asking price for the 24-year-old. (Mail)
Everton , Tottenham and newly promoted Ipswich are looking to sign 22-year-old Cameroon forward Karl Etta Eyong from Levante this summer. (Teamtalk)

Celtic turned down £25m from Nottingham Forest in January for midfielder Arne Engels but are now open to offers for the 22-year-old Belgium midfielder, with Crystal Palace and Borussia Dortmund also interested. (Football Insider)
Leeds are interested in signing Northern Ireland midfielder Shea Charles from Southampton this summer, with the 22-year-old valued at more than £20m. (Mail)
Leeds are also looking at a move for Germany forward Julian Brandt, 30, who is a free agent this summer after leaving Borussia Dortmund . (Yorkshire Evening Post)
Wolves are keen on bringing Scotland striker Che Adams, 29, back from Italian club Torino this summer. (Tuttomercato - in Italian)

Arsenal have had their first bid for Leicester City and England Under-19 winger Jeremy Monga rejected – the 19-year-old one of the club's long-term targets for the summer. (Telegraph - subscription required)
The Gunners are also preparing a bid for Paris St-Germain and France winger Bradley Barcola, 23. (Independent)
RB Leipzig have made contact with Everton over 23-year-old France Under-21 striker Thierno Barry. (Times - subscription required)

Real Madrid are looking to continue their summer rebuild by signing a midfielder and a centre-back, with Chelsea and Argentina midfielder Enzo Fernandez, 25, being one of the options highly rated by the club. (ESPN)

The Toffees are yet to receive a formal offer for Barry, but if a bid arrives from German side RB Leipzig or any other club, Everton 's football leadership group will decide how to proceed. (Liverpool Echo)
Tottenham are firmly in the mix to sign Anderlecht and Belgium midfielder Nathan De Cat, with Manchester United among the 17-year-old's other admirers from the Premier League. (Teamtalk)
Liverpool have reignited their interest in 25-year-old Juventus and France midfielder Khephren Thuram. (Corriere dello Sport via Football Talk)
The Reds are also pursuing a central midfielder, centre-back and right-back after triggering 22-year-old Osasuna and Spain winger Victor Munoz's 40m euro (£34.5m) release clause. (Football Insider)
Manchester United and Tottenham have made moves to sign Netherlands forward Crysencio Summerville, 24, from West Ham . (Teamtalk)
Chelsea are monitoring 26-year-old Porto goalkeeper Diogo Costa as they consider moving for the £51m-rated Portugal international. (Mirror)
Chelsea are interested in signing Italy full-back Andrea Cambiaso, 26, from Juventus and could offer Senegal striker Nicolas Jackson, 24, as part of the deal. (Gazzetta dello Sport - in Italian)

Real Madrid's bid for Atletico Madrid's Argentina striker Julian Alvarez, 26, was a 'phantom offer', with Bayern Munich's Michael Olise their top target, and Real remain hopeful of signing the 24-year-old France winger. (Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish)
Manchester United have no plans to negotiate a new loan agreement with Barcelona for England forward Marcus Rashford, 28. (ESPN)
Tottenham have turned down a second bid from Brighton worth £35m for 19-year-old Croatia centre-back Luka Vuskovic, who spent last season on loan at Hamburg. (Sky Sports)
Tottenham have opened talks over a deal for Germany Under-21 forward Said El Mala from Cologne and hope to beat Newcastle and Nottingham Forest to the 19-year-old's signature. (Teamtalk)
Lazio and Feyenoord are both monitoring the future of Manchester City 's 20-year-old English midfielder Charlie Gray. (Football Insider)
Gotham FC have agreed terms with 32-year-old Australia forward Sam Kerr, who is a free agent after leaving Women's Super League side Chelsea . (ESPN)

Tottenham have been encouraged to compete with Arsenal and Manchester City for Italy midfielder Sandro Tonali, with Newcastle 's asking price for the 26-year-old expected to be about £100m. (Telegraph - subscription required)
Real Madrid are plotting an £80m swoop for Manchester City 's Portugal centre-back Ruben Dias, 29. (Mirror)
Manchester United have valued Marcus Rashford at £40m but ruled out the possibility of the England forward, 28, joining Liverpool or Manchester City . (ESPN)

Manchester United are interested in West Ham pair Mateus Fernandes and Crysencio Summerville but the relegated Hammers want a combined £140m for Portugal midfielder Fernandes, 21, and Netherlands winger Summerville, 24. (Mail)

Arsenal have agreed personal terms with France midfielder Manu Kone but are yet to agree a fee with Roma , whose asking price for the 25-year-old is 50m euros (£43.2m). (Gazzetta dello Sport - in Italian)
Liverpool are continuing their efforts to sign Yan Diomande from RB Leipzig , with the Reds' new manager Andoni Iraola having sanctioned a move for the Ivory Coast winger, 19. (Teamtalk)

Manchester City and Chelsea have made contact with Italy right-back Marco Palestra's entourage but have not yet begun negotiations with the 21-year-old's club Atalanta . (Sky Sport Italia - in Italian)
Al-Hilal have renewed contact over a potential move for Barcelona's Raphinha but the Brazil forward, 29, does not want to discuss his future until after the World Cup. (Globo - in Portuguese)
Everton are exploring the possibility of signing 26-year-old Belgium striker Lois Openda on a loan-to-buy deal from Juventus . (Football Insider)
Leeds and Nottingham Forest are also in the race for Openda. (Teamtalk)

Marseille are open to offers for England midfielder Angel Gomes, with newly-promoted Premier League pair Coventry and Hull among the clubs interested in the 25-year-old, who ended last season on loan at Wolves . (Teamtalk)
Inter Milan have become the latest team to express an interest in signing France midfielder Eduardo Camavinga, 23, from Real Madrid this summer. (Mundo Deportivo - in Spanish)
Brighton are not willing to pay Tottenham 's £60m asking price for 19-year-old Croatia centre-back Luka Vuskovic, who spent last season on loan at Hamburg. (Football Insider)

Tottenham have rejected several approaches for English striker Will Lankshear, with Spurs wanting £20m for the 21-year-old, who impressed on loan at Oxford last season and is being monitored by Sporting . (Hayters)
Paris FC have spoken to former Chelsea and Strasbourg boss Liam Rosenior about the possibility of replacing Antoine Kombouare, if their current boss leaves this summer. (L'Equipe - in French)
Real Madrid have made contact regarding a move for West Ham 's Mateus Fernandes but Manchester United remain frontrunners for the Portugal midfielder, 21. (Teamtalk)
Manchester United are not prepared to meet West Ham 's asking price for Fernandes, which is about £80m, but he is also a target for Paris St-Germain as well as Real Madrid . (Mirror)
Bayern Munich are set to sign Morocco forward Ismael Saibari, 25, from PSV Eindhoven in a transfer worth more than £45m. (Talksport)

Real Madrid have inquired about Felix Nmecha's situation at Borussia Dortmund , although the Germany midfielder's former club Manchester City and their rivals Manchester United are also in the running for the 25-year-old. (Sky Sport Germany - in German)
Newcastle United are set to step up talks for Osasuna's 22-year-old Spain winger Victor Munoz this week. (Mail)

Barcelona's option to sign Marcus Rashford for 30m euros (£35m) is set to expire without them choosing to make the 28-year-old England forward's loan move from Manchester United a permanent switch. (ESPN)
Leeds United are lining up a move to sign Ivory Coast centre-back Ousmane Diomande from Sporting , which could see the 22-year-old replace Wales defender Joe Rodon, 28. (Football Insider)
Ipswich and Hull City are interested in England goalkeeper Nick Pope, with Newcastle willing to sell the 34-year-old for £5m. (Teamtalk)
West Ham are among a number of English clubs keeping tabs on the performance of Watford winger Nestory Irankunda, 20, for Australia at the World Cup. (Football Insider)

Arsenal have started talks about signing 18-year-old Lille midfielder Ayyoub Bouaddi, who helped Morocco to a 1-1 draw with Brazil in his country's opening game of the 2026 World Cup. (Times - subscription required)
Liverpool are also in negotiations for Bouaddi, while Chelsea and Paris St-Germain have been monitoring the player who might cost at least £60m. (Talksport)

Bayern Munich's move for PSV Eindhoven's Morocco striker Ismael Saibari, 25, could be made more difficult with his high-profile goal against Brazil at the World Cup set to drive up his price. (Bild - in German)

Brighton defender Jan Paul van Hecke, 26, says he will resolve his club future following the World Cup after the Seagulls rejected two bids from Tottenham for the Netherlands international. (Sky Sports)

Manchester City have set their sights on Everton centre-back Jarrad Branthwaite, 23, as a replacement for the departing John Stones, 32, but the Toffees want £70m for the England defender. (Football Insider)
Roma are set to make a £35m bid for England striker Mason Greenwood, 24, and include a sell-on clause which they hope will convince Marseille to agree to a deal. (Corriere dello Sport - in Italian)
Brazil midfielder Ederson was scheduled to have a medical on Sunday as the 26-year-old closed in on completing his move to Manchester United from Atalanta. (Corriere dello Sport - in Italian)

Manchester United sacked manager Ruben Amorim in January and could make a significant saving on the £15.9m compensation package following his departure if the Portuguese takes over at AC Milan. (Mirror)
Paris St-Germain are not opposed to selling France forward Bradley Barcola, with Arsenal and Liverpool among the teams interested in the 23-year-old. (L'Equipe, in French - subscription required)
Brighton have rejected a reported £20m bid from Coventry City for 24-year-old English goalkeeper Carl Rushworth. (Sky Sports)
Bayern Munich are prepared to beat Barcelona to the signing of Manchester United forward Marcus Rashford, 28. ( Fichajes - in Spanish )

Everton 's 26-year-old Senegal midfielder Iliman Ndiaye can add Arsenal to his list of suitors, with the Gunners joining Manchester City and Manchester United in monitoring him. (Mail - subscription required)
Nottingham Forest have submitted a near-£25m bid for Arsenal midfielder Fabio Viera, 26, who had a successful loan at Hamburg last season. ( Football Insider )
Forest may also add Inter Milan's Davide Frattesi to their midfield, with the 26-year-old out of favour at the San Siro. ( Football Italia )
Atletico Madrid will turn to Paris St-Germain attacker Lee Kang-in, 25, to replace the departed Antoine Griezmann. ( Fichajes - in Spanish )
Barcelona are interested in 18-year-old Australian defender Lucas Herrington, who is currently with Major League Soccer side Colorado Rapids . ( Goal )
Former Barcelona striker Robert Lewandowski, 37, and ex- Bayern Munich midfielder Leon Goretzka, 31, might move to MLS side Chicago Fire . ( Yahoo Sports )
Roberto Mancini is ready for a second spell as the head coach of Italy, after leaving Qatari club Al-Sadd . ( Fabrizio Romano )

Real Madrid are expected to complete the signing of Portugal midfielder Bernardo Silva, 31, to kick off Jose Mourinho's second spell at the club, when his contract expires at Manchester City later this month. (Mail - subscription required)
Bayern Munich believe they can secure the signing of Manchester United and England forward, Marcus Rashford, 28, following positive talks with his representatives. (Teamtalk)
Manchester United are increasingly confident of landing Portugal and West Ham midfielder Mateus Fernandes, 21, after fending off interest from Arsenal . (Times -subscription required)

Newcastle have rekindled their interest in signing Manchester City and England goalkeeper James Trafford, 23, as work continues to bolster the club's goalkeeping unit. (Athletic - subscription required)
Arsenal are weighing up a move for Real Sociedad and Spain winger Ander Barrenetxea, who has also been watched by Tottenham . (Sun)

Leeds and Liverpool are both interested in Midtjylland and South Korea central defender Lee Han-beom, 23, with Napoli , Monaco and Lyon among a number of other clubs keeping tabs on the player. (Teamtalk)
Brighton & Hove Albion have made a £30m offer to sign Croatia defender Luka Vuskovic, 19, from Tottenham . (Athletic - subscription required)
Besiktas have entered advanced talks with Arsenal forward Leandro Trossard, 31, over a £20m transfer. ( Caught Offside )
Galatasaray are interested in signing Aston Villa 's Emiliano Buendia, 29, and Unai Emery's side could replace him with West Ham 's Crysencio Summerville, 24. ( Football Insider )
Barcelona will look to offload out of favour goalkeeper Marc-Andre ter Stegen, 34, to Ajax . ( Fichajes - in Spanish )
Manchester United are interested in Newcastle and England defender Lewis Hall, 21, who wants to leave the Magpies. (Sun)
Fulham and United States left-back Antonee Robinson, 28, is also being viewed by Manchester United as a possible signing for next season. (Sky Sports)

Barcelona will not match the financial packages being offered to Portugal midfielder Bernardo Silva, 31, by Atletico Madrid and Real Madrid, who are both keen on signing him when his contract expires at Manchester City at the end of June. (Marca - in Spanish)
Real Madrid appear to be the favourites to sign Silva and are in advanced talks over personal terms. (Fabrizio Romano)
Manchester City and Croatia defender Josko Gvardiol, 24, has emerged as Jose Mourinho's preferred target to strengthen Real Madrid's defence. (Teamtalk)
Former Manchester United boss Ruben Amorim, 41, is attracting interest from AC Milan , who believe the Portuguese boss could provide fresh energy. (Fichajes - in Spanish)
Barcelona are set to reject the chance to sign Manchester United forward Marcus Rashford, 28, for his £26m release fee, with the clause set to expire on Monday. ( Daily Mirror )
Manchester United may also move for Lens midfielder Mamadou Sangare, 23, having been priced out of a move for Nottingham Forest 's England midfielder Elliot Anderson, 23. ( Teamtalk )
Borussia Dortmund and Germany defender Nico Schlotterbeck, 26, is putting a potential move to Real Madrid to the back of his mind to focus on the World Cup. (Bild - in German)
Trabzonspor are eager to secure the permanent transfer of Manchester United and Cameroon goalkeeper Andre Onana, 30, this summer. (Mirror)
Manchester United are also looking to offload Turkey goalkeeper Altay Bayindir, 28, and Czech stopper Radek Vitek, 22, who was on loan at Bristol City last season. (Sky Sports)
Sunderland have joined the race to sign highly rated Bosnia forward Kerim Alajbegovic, 18, from Red Bull Salzburg . (Teamtalk)
Wolves could be tempted to reunite West Ham 's Pablo, 22, with their new head coach Cesar Peixoto, who worked with the forward at Portuguese side Gil Vincente. ( Football Insider )
Real Madrid are looking to loan Argentinian forward Franco Mastantuono, 18, to Juventus . ( TuttoSport - in Italian )
Arsenal remain firmly in the hunt to sign Athletic Club and Spain winger Nico Williams, with Liverpool , Manchester City and Manchester United also interested in the 23-year-old. (Teamtalk)
Juventus are in talks with Aston Villa to sign their Argentina goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez, 33, who has already agreed personal terms. (Corriere dello Sport - in Italian)
Paris St-Germain will to try to sign Bayern Munich's 24-year-old French forward Michael Olise this summer. (L'Equipe - in French)
Manchester United are monitoring Everton 's 26-year-old Senegal forward Iliman Ndiaye as they look to bolster their squad for a Champions League return next season (Sky Sports)
Liverpool are prepared to let Italy forward Federico Chiesa, 28, leave this summer for around £17m, with the player keen on a move back to Serie A. (Caughtoffside)
Barcelona are aware of interest from Chelsea and Arsenal in Spain winger Dani Olmo, but will only allow the 28-year-old to leave if their £60m valuation is met. (Fichajes - in Spanish)
France forward Mathys Tel, 21, could make a shock switch from Tottenham to Bournemouth this summer. (Teamtalk) .
Barcelona intend to sell Spain midfielder Marc Casado to raise money for other signings, with Bayer Leverkusen and Premier League clubs tracking the 22-year-old. (Fichajes - in Spanish)
Leeds United want to break their transfer record to sign Ivory Coast defender Ousmane Diomande from Sporting , with an offer of up to £35m and another £8m in add-ons. (Mirror)
Crystal Palace are preparing to rival Everton for Middlesbrough's English midfielder Hayden Hackney, 23, this summer with a £20m offer. (Mail)
Real Madrid are interested in Arsenal and Italy defender Riccardo Calafiori, 24, who previously played under Jose Mourinho at Roma. (Sky Sports)
Tottenham are considering a move for Juventus and Brazil defender Gleison Bremer, 29, to replace 28-year-old Argentina international Cristian Romero in central defence. (Tuttosport - in Italian)
Manchester United are not interested in signing Romero from Tottenham but are interested in Newcastle 's versatile 21-year-old English defender Lewis Hall. (Teamtalk)
Co-owner Sir Jim Ratcliffe is willing to satisfy the wage demands of Nottingham Forest midfielder Elliot Anderson, 23, in order to bring him to Manchester United . (Mirror)
Manchester City remain the frontrunners to sign Anderson despite United's efforts to steal a march on their rivals. (Star - subscription required)
Incoming Real Madrid boss Mourinho is keen on West Ham 's 21-year-old Portugal midfielder Mateus Fernandes who is also of interest to Chelsea . (AS - in Spanish)
Manchester United are also exploring a deal for Fernandes with West Ham valuing the player at about £80m, but the London club are in no rush to sell him. (Sky Sports)

Manchester United are considering a surprise move for 35-year-old English goalkeeper Karl Darlow, who is out of contract at Leeds this summer, with Turkish shot-stopper Altay Bayindir, 28, set leave Old Trafford. ( Talksport )

Fulham are interested in signing Nigeria midfielder Samuel Chukwueze from AC Milan following the 27-year-old's season-long loan at Craven Cottage, but are trying to negotiate a smaller fee. (Gazzetta dello Sport - in Italian)

Atletico Madrid are hopeful of persuading former Manchester City midfielder Bernando Silva to join them instead of Barcelona or Real Madrid because they can offer the 31-year-old Portuguese more game time. (Marca - in Spanish)
Fulham are weighing up whether to trigger the £8m release clause of Ipswich head coach Kieran McKenna , who leads their list of candidates to replace Marco Silva. ( Talksport )
Leicester are in talks with former Southampton and Rangers head coach Russell Martin about taking over the club following their relegation to League One. ( Leicester Mercury )
Tottenham are advancing in talks over a deal worth about £60m for Manchester City 's Brazil winger Savinho, 22. (Mail)

Manchester United remain intent on signing Elliot Anderson, with the club's executives optimistic they can beat Manchester City in the race to acquire the 23-year-old England midfielder, who is valued at about £100m by Nottingham Forest . (Guardian)
Anderson is said to have expressed a desire to join Manchester City over Manchester United . (Talksport)

Atletico Madrid and Barcelona are best positioned to make a move for Chelsea 's Marc Cucurella, 26, with the Spain defender keen on a change of scenery after four years at Stamford Bridge. (Marca - in Spanish)

Newcastle will target Monaco's 22-year-old Senegal midfielder Lamine Camara should Italy's Sandro Tonali or Englishman Joe Willock, both 26, be among the midfielders to leave St James' Park this summer. (Telegraph - subscription required)
Manchester United scouts assessed highly rated Inter Milan striker Pio Esposito, 20, in action for Italy in a friendly against Greece. (Teamtalk)

Paris St-Germain's 27-year-old France forward Randal Kolo Muani, who spent last season on loan at Tottenham , wants to join Juventus where he had a six-month loan spell in 2025. (Tuttosport - in Italian)
Manchester City are weighing up moves for Real Madrid's Brazil winger Rodrygo, 25, and 26-year-old Everton and Senegal wideman Iliman Ndiaye. (Mail)
Portugal centre-back Goncalo Inacio, 24, of Sporting is on Liverpool 's list of replacements for departing defender Ibrahima Konate. (Caughtoffside)
Atalanta are in talks with Nottingham Forest over a deal to bring Italian centre-back Nicolo Savona, 23, back to Serie A. (Goal - in Italian)
AC Milan are set to hold a second round of talks with ex- Crystal Palace boss Oliver Glasner to become their new coach. (Calciomercato - in Italian)
Real Madrid are set to join the race to sign Portugal midfielder Mateus Fernandes, 21, following West Ham 's relegation from the Premier League. (Sun)
Brighton have rejected a second bid from Tottenham Hotspur for Netherlands centre-back Jan Paul van Hecke, 25. (Talksport)
Harry Maguire could be allowed to leave Manchester United this summer, just months after the England defender, 33, signed a new contract. (Football Insider)
Inter Milan have made an offer for England midfielder Curtis Jones, 25, but are currently some way short of Liverpool 's valuation. (Gazzetta dello Sport - in Italian)
Liverpool could use Netherlands forward Cody Gakpo, 27, as leverage in their bid to sign Ivory Coast winger Yan Diomande, 19, from RB Leipzig . (Teamtalk)
Bayern Munich have said they have no intention of selling Michael Olise after Real Madrid said they would offer £130m for the France winger, 24. (Bild - in German)
Bernardo Silva says that joining Barcelona is "an option" after leaving Manchester City but the Portugal midfielder, 31, is yet to make a decision on his future. (Marca - in Spanish)
Tottenham 's Italy international Guglielmo Vicario, 29, has emerged as the frontrunner as Juventus look to sign a new goalkeeper. (Gazzetta dello Sport - in Italian)

Coventry City have submitted a club-record £20m bid for Carl Rushworth, the 24-year-old English goalkeeper who helped the Sky Blues win the Championship while on loan from Brighton last season. (Talksport)

Nottingham Forest 's Morgan Gibbs-White, 26, is on Arsenal 's shortlist as a ­possible alternative to another England forward, Aston Villa 's 23-year-old Morgan Rogers, but the Gunners face competition for Gibbs-White from Paris St-Germain . (Sun)

PSG's Georgia winger Khvicha Kvaratskhelia, 25, is the mystery player Florentino Perez is planning to move for should he win Real Madrid's presidential election, sources close to the Spanish club believe. (Teamtalk)
New Real Madrid coach Jose Mourinho wants to sign Bernardo Silva after the Portugal midfielder, 31, left Manchester City at the end of the season. (AS - in Spanish)

Jurgen Klopp's agent says the German does not want to "work as a coach at a club" after Real Madrid presidential candidate Enrique Riquelme said he planned to make a move for the former Liverpool boss if elected. (Sky Sports Germany)
Tottenham are still interested in Savinho and the Brazil winger, 22, will push for the move after Manchester City turned down a bid from Spurs last summer. (Mirror)
Liverpool 's Federico Chiesa says he needs to play more and the Italy forward, 28, will talk with new Reds boss Andoni Iraola before deciding on his future. (Gazzetta dello Sport - in Italian)
Liverpool are not looking to sell Rio Ngumoha despite Bayern Munich reportedly exploring a summer move for the 17-year-old English winger. (Sky Sports)
Newcastle United 's English winger Harvey Barnes, 28, has emerged as a target for Aston Villa . (Football Insider)
Leeds United and Ipswich Town are competing to sign 34-year-old England goalkeeper Nick Pope from Newcastle . (Sun)
Russell Martin is in advanced talks with Leicester City as the Englishman weighs up a return to management in League One. (Telegraph - subscription required)
Real Madrid will make a £130m move for Bayern Munich and France winger Michael Olise, 24, if Florentino Perez is elected as the club's president. (Telegraph - subscription required)

Former Liverpool manager Arne Slot, who was sacked by the Reds last week, has rejected the chance to take over as Fulham boss in the wake of Marco Silva announcing he will be leaving the London club. (Talksport)

Barcelona's move for Argentina striker Julian Alvarez has stalled and Atletico Madrid are planning for next season with the 26-year-old among their ranks as, while Arsenal are also interested, he is not keen on a move to London. (Cadena Ser - in Spanish)
Chelsea 's English striker Liam Delap, 23, could join Fulham if his former boss at Ipswich Town , Kieran McKenna, takes over from Marco Silva at Craven Cottage. (Talksport)
Former Crystal Palace boss Oliver Glasner has the edge over USA coach Mauricio Pochettino to become the new AC Milan manager. (Gazzetta dello Sport - in Italian)
AC Milan forward Rafael Leao, 26, says he needs a new challenge, with the Portugal international believing a move to the Premier League or La Liga would suit him. (Sport TV, via Football Italia)
RB Leipzig remain confident that 19-year-old Ivory Coast forward Yan Diomande will stay at the club this summer despite Liverpool 's growing determination to sign him. (Teamtalk)
Newcastle United are set to make their first signing of the summer after agreeing a £24m deal for Reims' 20-year-old French goalkeeper Ewen Jaouen. ( Northern Echo)
Tottenham manager Roberto de Zerbi wants 19-year-old Croatia defender Luka Vuskovic to leave the club this summer. ( Football Insider)
Newly promoted Hull City are exploring the conditions to sign 19-year-old Venezuelan winger Luis Fernando Carrero from Deportivo Tachira this summer, and then loan him to NK Maribor . (Sky Sports)
Everton have contacted Middlesbrough about English midfielder Hayden Hackney but the Toffees are way off Boro's valuation of the 23-year-old. (Teesside Live)
Barcelona will move to sign Marc Cucurella, 27, from Chelsea should they decide to sell fellow Spanish defender Alejandro Balde, 22, this summer. (Marca - in Spanish)

Arsenal face competition from Paris St-Germain in trying to sign French forward Eli Junior Kroupi, 19, from Bournemouth and Argentina striker Julian Alvarez, 26, from Atletico Madrid. (Independent)
Brentford have made an offer worth 50m euros (£43m) for Cologne's German winger Said El Mala, 19. (Bild - in German)
However, El Mala has told Brentford that he does not want to join the Premier League club. (Sky Sports Germany)
Chelsea defender Marc Cucurella, 27, is exploring a move away from Stamford Bridge, with Atletico Madrid set to make an opening offer for the Spain international. ( Teamtalk )
Juventus want at least 30m euros (£26m) for 26-year-old Italian full-back Andrea Cambiaso, who has been linked with Chelsea and Barcelona. (Calciomercato - in Italian)
